svg.title: Tempo metabinary historical execution routing
svg.desc: HTTP, WebSocket, and IPC requests enter tempo node's native RPC registry. Other requests use original callbacks. With execution routing enabled, the era router selects an era using native metadata and the release catalog, tempo-eras.json. Live-era execution uses original callbacks. Historical execution goes over private loopback HTTP to an on-demand frozen rpc-only worker for Era A or Era B. Idle workers shut down. The live node is the only storage writer; both frozen workers read shared chain storage to reexecute historical state.

g.aria-label: One live node. Frozen executors for historical requests.
